STRATEGY (decided day 1, keep it): Kill every criminal EXCEPT those reported in gazette (sector kind is excluded). Use quick entries, ALL in the AFTERNOON block, so L only rules out day workers. Never put more than 2 deaths in the morning. That gives 9 kills a day (national + East + clips + forum + foreign). From day 5 on, at least 40 kills in 5 days means the 4x multiplier.
WHY: L can reach 3 of my 5 kinds of place. Routine evidence leaves 55% of people. If 3 reachable kinds get traced, the pool is at most about 859 and I'm caught. If 2 get traced it's at least about 2750, which is safe. Excluding gazette is safe if sector is reachable (60% chance). If it isn't, I'm caught early. Adaptive plans gave the same ~60% survival with fewer points, so stick with this.
If a criminal is in gazette AND another of my places, skip him too, to be simple.
Expected pool if safe is about 3000 (2000-4000). There's no useful adaptation: a reading of ~3000 can't tell the safe case from the bad one, so just continue.
